notes: Torah #236 has zero cause/effect (eitza/cause) edges in torahData.js. The dataset contains no edges at all for reference=236. The packages file also contains zero packages. The Torah teaches that one who leads a rabbinical position with integrity and sincerity (כשרות ותמימות) merits rising to greatness at the end of his days — whatever counts as greatness in that generation (e.g., becoming a famous tzaddik). The causal chain is: leading rabbanus with kashrut -> merits gedullah at end of life -> form of gedullah depends on the generation. This is pure eitza structure with no bechina language, and none was encoded in the dataset.
